proposal.hypothesis: A matching 256-thread CTA and 256-source tile may reduce tile-loop and synchronization overhead while letting each staged source serve 256 target threads. This uses more shared memory per CTA than the measured 128/128 configuration, so occupancy or resource costs may offset that reuse; official timing must decide.

retained: Set block and items_per_block to 256 and configure 4096 bytes for a 256-entry, 16-byte shared source tile.
Cooperatively stage bounded source chunks and synchronize before consumption and before replacing each chunk; keep all threads participating, including inactive target-tail threads.

Keep one target and force accumulator per thread, exclude self-interactions by global index, guard partial source tiles and target tails, and preserve particle mass and the original integration expressions.
